title: Counit normalization of the site-transported closed adjoint
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and $R=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow P$ be a closed immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Write $S_T=\nu_T^*$ and $U_T=R\nu_{T,*}$ for etale/pro-etale comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $I=Ri^!_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the ordinary etale closed right adjoint [lem-exc-closed-ambient], and $J=S_Z I U_P$ for the finite transported exceptional functor [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], identifying the etale compact-support adjoint with $I$ by its counit-compatible adjunction comparison. Give $J$ the bounded-below etale-origin Hom bijections of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class] for the identity-open compactification of $i$. Let $H\in D^+(P_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ and suppose $IH\in D^+(Z_{\mathrm{et}},R)$. Let $\eta_H:H\xrightarrow{\sim}U_PS_PH$ be the specified comparison unit [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], and set
$$\alpha_H=S_ZI(\eta_H):S_ZIH\xrightarrow{\sim}JS_PH.$$
For bounded-below $L$ let $\delta_L:S_Pi_*^{\mathrm{et}}L\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}S_ZL$ be the normalized canonical comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. With $e_H:i_*^{\mathrm{et}}IH\to H$ the etale exceptional counit and $E_{S_PH}:i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}JS_PH\to S_PH$ the transported exceptional counit, one has
$$E_{S_PH}\circ i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}(\alpha_H)\circ\delta_{IH}=S_P(e_H).$$
More generally the transported exceptional adjunct of $S_P(f)\circ\delta_L^{-1}$, for $f:i_*^{\mathrm{et}}L\to H$, is $\alpha_H\circ S_Z(\widehat f)$, where $\widehat f:L\to IH$ is the etale exceptional adjunct.

proof.text: Put $F=i_*^{\mathrm{et}}$, $Q=i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}$, and let $\beta$ be the ordinary adjunction bijection. Apply [lem-coef-closed-identity-open-hom-normalization]: $\alpha_H$ is invertible, $(IH,\alpha_H)$ is a bounded-below etale-origin witness for $JS_PH$, and the specified relative bijection $\Phi_{L,H}$ sends $g$ successively to $g\delta_L$, $U_P(g\delta_L)\eta_{FL}$, its ordinary adjunct, and its $S_Z$-image. In particular the relative counit at $S_PH$ is defined.

proof.text:
For $f:FL\to H$ set $g=S_P(f)\delta_L^{-1}$. Then $g\delta_L=S_P(f)$. Unit naturality [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison] and target naturality of $F\dashv I$ [lem-exc-closed-ambient] give
$$U_PS_P(f)\eta_{FL}=\eta_H f,\qquad
\beta_{L,U_PS_PH}(\eta_H f)=I(\eta_H)\beta_{L,H}(f)=I(\eta_H)\widehat f.$$
Apply $S_Z$ to this last equality and use functoriality in the chain from Step 1:
$$\Phi_{L,H}(S_P(f)\delta_L^{-1})=S_Z(I(\eta_H))S_Z(\widehat f)=\alpha_H S_Z(\widehat f).$$
This proves the general adjunct formula without assuming a transported-counit identity.

proof.text:
Take $L=IH$, $f=e_H$. The ordinary counit has $\beta_{IH,H}(e_H)=1_{IH}$ by [lem-exc-closed-ambient], so Step 2 gives $\Phi_{IH,H}(S_P(e_H)\delta_{IH}^{-1})=\alpha_H$. The relative counit $E=E_{S_PH}$ is the inverse image of $1_{JS_PH}$ under the stipulated relative Hom bijection. Its source is allowed by Step 1. Source naturality of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class] applied to $\alpha_H:S_ZIH\to JS_PH$ gives
$$\Phi_{IH,H}(E\circ Q(\alpha_H))=1_{JS_PH}\circ\alpha_H=\alpha_H.$$
Injectivity identifies $E\circ Q(\alpha_H)=S_P(e_H)\circ\delta_{IH}^{-1}$. Precomposing with $\delta_{IH}$ and cancelling its inverse yields
$$E_{S_PH}\circ i_*^{\mathrm{pro}}(\alpha_H)\circ\delta_{IH}=S_P(e_H).$$
Together with Step 2 this gives both clauses, using only the stated bounded-below hypotheses.
